description:
[Game reference] One explosive: damage, radius, fuse, duds, fire, walls it breaks. One explosive with every field `/explosives` gives (see there), including `walls`: the number that breaks one
wood, stone, sheet metal and armored wall from outside and inside. For a deployable target (turret, box, TC,
door...) use `/raid/deployables/{shortname}`. Blast radius, fuse, dud chance, fire and walls broken for one explosive (c4, satchel, rocket, beancan...). Satchels dud 20%: say so. Link https://rust.wiki/explosives.
